column1: Clause 4  : This clause inserts new sections 3A, 3B, 3C and 3D in the principal enactment and
the  legal  effect  of  the  section  is  to  –

column2: set  out  a  new  procedure  for  registering  a  power  of  attorney  relating  to  a
transaction  which  falls  within  the  scope  of  the  Prevention  of  Frauds
require  the  notary  public  to  verify  the  validity  of  a  power  of  attorney  prior
to  the  attestation  of  a  deed  or  instrument;
specify  the  validity  period  of  a  power  of  attorney;
restrict  the  execution  of  an  irrevocable  power  of  attorney.
